name: player touches from plays — basic
description: Verifies the combined SQL aggregate for player_touches_from_plays (rush attempts + completed receptions) over nfl_plays. Spot-validated against 2024 REG-season top-10 RB/WR totals; delta vs (rush_attempts + receptions) = 0 for all rows.
expected_query: with "t3553cc878c4327b053d54a3874c517c4" as materialized (select COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid, target_pid) as pid, SUM(CASE WHEN ball_carrier_pid IS NOT NULL OR (target_pid IS NOT NULL AND is_completion = true) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as touches_from_plays from "nfl_plays" where "play_type" in ('PASS', 'RUSH', 'KOFF', 'PUNT', 'FGXP', 'FREE') group by COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid, target_pid)), "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2026]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t3553cc878c4327b053d54a3874c517c4"."touches_from_plays" AS "touches_from_plays_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "t3553cc878c4327b053d54a3874c517c4" on "t3553cc878c4327b053d54a3874c517c4"."pid" = "player"."pid" where player.primary_position IN ('RB', 'WR') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t3553cc878c4327b053d54a3874c517c4"."touches_from_plays", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by 4 DESC NULLS LAST, "player"."pid" asc limit 10
